subject: Hospitality
title: Trade Shows: The Marketplace Floor
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Trade Shows: The Marketplace Floor.

hook.text: Trade Shows: a surprising example shows why better reasoning matters.

buildup.text: Trade Shows sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: The real product isn't the booth—it's the leads. Companies measure success by qualified leads generated per dollar of booth cost.

twist.text: Digital alternatives haven't killed trade shows—they've amplified them. Online launches drive MORE people to see products live.

climax.text: The largest shows create ecosystems: CES in Las Vegas takes over 40+ hotels and generates $300+ million in local economic impact.

punchline.text: $13 billion, face-to-face selling. Trade shows prove that screens can't replace.

quiz.question: What is CES's economic impact on Las Vegas?
options: $300+ million in local economic impact using 40+ hotels
